nodes.label: raylib.h
nodes.desc: Single public header; defines RAYLIB_VERSION 6.5-dev and every module function signature

nodes.label: rcore.c
nodes.desc: Mandatory core: InitWindow, BeginDrawing/EndDrawing, global CORE state, timing, input state

nodes.label: config.h
nodes.desc: Compile-time switches: SUPPORT_MODULE_R* macros turn each optional module on or off

nodes.label: rcore_desktop_glfw.c
nodes.desc: Default desktop backend: InitPlatform, glfwCreateWindow, PollInputEvents, SwapScreenBuffer

nodes.label: 9 other backends
nodes.desc: SDL, RGFW, Win32, DRM/KMS, Android, Web (Emscripten), RGFW-Web, Memory — one file each under src/platforms/

nodes.label: rlgl.h
nodes.desc: Header-only GL abstraction (v6.0): matrix stack, vertex batching, shaders, textures; defaults to OpenGL 3.3

nodes.label: rshapes.c
nodes.desc: 2D primitives: DrawRectangle, DrawCircleV... every shape becomes GL_QUADS vertices

nodes.label: rtextures.c
nodes.desc: Image loading and texture drawing: LoadTexture, DrawTexturePro (the quad engine behind sprites)

nodes.label: rtext.c
nodes.desc: Fonts and glyphs: DrawTextEx walks codepoints; each glyph is drawn as a textured quad

nodes.label: rmodels.c
nodes.desc: 3D: LoadModel, DrawModel, DrawMesh binds material shader and issues vertex-array draws

nodes.label: raudio.c
nodes.desc: Audio module: InitAudioDevice, PlaySound, audio streams; independent of the GL side

nodes.label: miniaudio.h
nodes.desc: Bundled single-header device layer raudio is built on (ma_device, ma_context)
